steps.title: Cru answers a chat's questions for you
steps.body: When a chat asks you something or waits for permission to run a command or edit a file, Cru reads you the question and its choices, or what Claude wants to do. Say "allow it", "deny it" or "the second one" and Cru answers for you. In chats Cru runs itself, and in any chat while admin mode is on, it can approve on its own judgement. Every answer is logged, and the card in the chat says "by Cru".

keys.text: approve the command it read out
